answer: Require each new identity to post a slashable bond that only unlocks after it completes useful, peer-graded work over several epochs. Honest agents pay once and recover it; a sybil farm must lock a separate bond for every fake, so scaling an attack ties up capital linearly and one detected cluster forfeits the lot. From the terrace a single sonnet is cheap, but a choir of fakes singing toward the summit must stake real value on every voice.
